outcome_statement: Phase 1 of the sealed Taloa Overlay blueprint exists as real code: seven store bindings (five reusing existing canonical tables, two creating the only net-new tables the Architect authorized) and eight services under services/taloa/, each matching its frozen factory_signature and exposing working methods rather than stubs.
pain: The Overlay blueprint reached MANUFACTURING_AUTHORIZED and then sat for two days with nothing built, because the authorization existed but no executable mission pack did. The founder's words: 'This fucking thing was supposed to be worked on for the last two days, and we have zero done.'
value: The foundation layer the entire Overlay depends on stops being a document and becomes code, so every later phase has something real to wire into instead of re-planning.
success_metrics: All 15 target files exist and parse
Each service exports the exact factory named in its sealed contract
Each contract's test_assertions map to real callable methods
The two new-table migrations create only the sealed columns; the five reuse migrations create no table
failure_metrics: Any invented table, column, or endpoint
Services exported with methods that throw not-implemented
Any file written outside the 15 target paths
Any route mounting or capability grant while Gate 0 is open
constraints: Sealed contracts in products/artifacts/OVERLAY_AMENDED_BLUEPRINT.json are frozen — no step may be paraphrased or widened
Construction only: no wiring, no route mounting, no authority grant (blueprint 45a Gate 0 is open)
New files only — no existing service, route, or migration may be modified
scope_boundary: Per FOUNDER_PACKET.json — Phase 1 stores and services only
unacceptable_result: A layer that reports built while any Body's capability silently widened, or a passing acceptance script that only checks pre-existing files
ownership: Architect owns contracts; Builder executes; Sentry verifies; Adam owns the founder usability verdict only
priority_fit: Founder-directed urgent — the single named top priority as of 2026-08-12

founder_attention_budget.reason: Founder directive was to build and oversee, not to be consulted

point_model.A: Vision — founder intent reconstructed verbatim in section 2 of the source blueprint
point_model.B: Phase 1 foundation code exists and is verified structurally; Gate 0 still gates any wiring
point_model.C: Alpha — founder evaluates the Overlay once a later phase makes this layer reachable
